C: C1 [ C ] written abbreviation oz a unit of weight equal to approximately 28 grams
盎司（重量單位，1盎司約等於28克）
S: C2 [ S ] informal a very small amount

example: There are 16 ounces in one pound.
She can eat as much as she wants and she never puts on an ounce (= her weight does not increase).
她可以想吃多少就吃多少，體重卻一點都不長。
If he has an ounce of common sense, he'll realize that this project is bound to fail.
要是他稍稍有點常識，就會意識到這項企劃案註定要失敗。
